subject: Cannot log in to my account
body: Hi, I have been trying to log in to my account for the past two hours and keep getting an 'Invalid credentials' error even though I am sure my password is correct. I tried resetting my password but the reset email never arrived. Please help urgently.
resolution: Confirmed the reset email was going to spam. Resent the reset link manually and asked the customer to whitelist our domain. Issue resolved within 10 minutes.

subject: Overcharged on my invoice
body: I noticed I was charged $149 this month but my plan should only be $99. I did not upgrade anything. Please refund the difference or explain the charge.
resolution: Found that a pro-rated charge for a seat added mid-cycle was applied. Issued a $50 credit to the next invoice and sent a detailed breakdown.

subject: App crashes on startup after update
body: Since updating to version 3.2.1 the desktop app crashes immediately on launch. I am on Windows 11. I tried reinstalling but the problem persists. Error in event log: 'Unhandled exception in module core.dll'.
resolution: Identified a compatibility issue with the 3.2.1 build on Windows 11. Provided a rollback installer for v3.2.0 and escalated to engineering. A hotfix (v3.2.2) was released within 48 hours.

subject: Request: dark mode for the mobile app
body: I love the product but would really appreciate a dark mode option for the iOS app. My eyes get tired when using it at night. Is this on the roadmap?
resolution: Logged the request in our feature tracker and informed the customer that dark mode is planned for Q3. Sent a link to the public roadmap.

subject: Data export not working
body: I am trying to export my data to CSV but every time I click Export I get a 500 Internal Server Error. This is urgent — I need the export for a meeting tomorrow morning.
resolution: Found a bug in the export service affecting large datasets. Triggered a manual export server-side and emailed the CSV directly. Engineering deployed a fix within 6 hours.

subject: How do I add team members?
body: Hi, I just upgraded to the Team plan. I want to invite my colleagues but cannot find where to do it in the settings. Can you point me in the right direction?
resolution: Directed the customer to Settings > Team > Invite Members and shared a link to the onboarding guide KB article.

subject: Two-factor authentication codes not working
body: My 2FA codes from the authenticator app are being rejected. I have tried generating several new codes but none work. I cannot access my account.
resolution: Discovered the customer's device clock was out of sync. Advised them to enable automatic time sync. After syncing, 2FA codes worked correctly. Also offered to disable 2FA temporarily if needed.

subject: Subscription cancellation not processed
body: I cancelled my subscription three weeks ago through the website but I was still charged this month. I am very frustrated and want a full refund for this charge.
resolution: Found that the cancellation request did not complete due to a UI bug. Processed the cancellation manually, issued a full refund, and escalated the UI bug to engineering.

subject: Slow dashboard loading times
body: The main dashboard has been loading very slowly for the past week — sometimes 15-20 seconds. My internet is fine and other sites are fast. Has something changed?
resolution: Infrastructure team identified increased database query times after a schema migration. Deployed an index fix. Advised the customer to clear cache; loading times returned to normal (<2s).

subject: Security concern: suspicious login attempt
body: I received an email saying someone tried to log in to my account from an IP address in Russia. I did not attempt this login. Is my account compromised? What should I do?
resolution: Immediately locked the account as a precaution, confirmed no unauthorised changes, forced a password reset, and recommended enabling 2FA. Sent a security checklist to the customer.

subject: API rate limit errors
body: We are hitting rate limit errors on your REST API even though we are well within our plan's stated limits. Error: 429 Too Many Requests. This is blocking our production pipeline.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured rate limit for the customer's API key tier. Updated the limit configuration and added a 30-day temporary increase while investigating. Shared retry-with-backoff best practices.

subject: Need invoice with VAT number
body: Could you please issue a corrected invoice for last month that includes our company VAT number? Our accounts department cannot process payment without it.
resolution: Updated the billing record with the VAT number and re-issued the invoice. Sent the corrected PDF within 2 hours.
